root_cause: In the hide method, focus is restored to the previously focused element before removing the focus trap listener, causing the listener to return focus to the dialog after the attempt to focus the opener.
repair_strategy: Reorder the hide method to remove the focus and keydown listeners before restoring focus to the previously focused element.
expected_accessibility_effect: After closing the dialog with Escape, focus returns to the opener button, preserving logical tab order and meeting WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility.
functional_risks: Removing listeners earlier could theoretically affect any cleanup logic that relies on them, but the dialog is already hidden and no further key events should be processed.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape on the open dialog results in focus on the opener button.
Verify that the dialog remains inert (aria-hidden true) after closing.
Verify that while the dialog is open, Tab key trapping still works correctly.
